problem: Let $C={{c}_{1},{c}_{2}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{2}$ and $[x]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$ What are the coordinates of $x$ relative to the basis $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ where ${b}_{1}={c}_{2}$ and ${b}_{2}=-{c}_{1}?$
worked_solution:
Since $[x]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$, we can write $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =-{c}_{1}+2{c}_{2} \\  & =2{c}_{2}-{c}_{1} \\  & =2{c}_{2}+(-{c}_{1}) \\  & =2{b}_{1}+{b}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$
